title: When all parallel sets of a $ C^1 $-hypersurface are nowhere $ C^1 $-regular
summary: We prove a necessary and sufficient condition for a $ C^1 $-hypersurface to have all parallel sets nowhere $ C^1 $-regular. As a corollary, we deduce that for a generic $ C^1 $-regular convex body all interior parallel bodies have nowhere $ C^1 $-regular boundaries.
